KSA REAL ESTATE

ICE CREAM SHOP / TAKE AWAY FOR TRANSFER IN PLAZA DE CHUECA (MADRID)

Unique opportunity in the heart of Chueca! A spectacular 50 m² commercial space is available for transfer in one of the most dynamic, touristy, and busy areas of Madrid.
The premises are newly renovated and fully equipped, allowing you to start your business immediately without wasting time or money on construction.
• � Premium Location: Plaza de Chueca, Madrid (steps from the Chueca Metro station).
• � Active License: Ice cream shop and take away.
• � Surface Area: 50 m² in excellent condition.
• �♂️ Pedestrian Flow: Established commercial area with a very high influx of local and international public 7 days a week.
Perfect for entrepreneurs or brands looking for a strategic location ready to operate in the center of Madrid.
